notes:
Seabyss II — Beta 0.1.7-beta.48

- Fixes intermittent Quest Claim and Cauldron Try Again responses caused by temporary profile-admission contention.
- Keeps the original operation pending for a bounded maximum of 45 seconds and resumes it without a blind economic retry.
- Preserves exactly-once, replay, reconnect and reconciliation safeguards.
- Enables the compact provider-fenced path for new Quest reward transactions, reducing blocking profile saves.
- Preserves all gameplay, UI, portraits, navigation, economy and player-work changes already validated in Beta.47.
- Purchases and all financial gates remain disabled for this Beta release.
